pokedexEntries.rb: Long considered a mythical POKéMON until recently when a small colony was found living underwater.

pokedexEntries.ye: The existence of this mythical POKéMON was only recently confirmed by a fisherman who caught one.

pokedexEntries.go: It is born large to start with. It repeatedly sheds its skin as it steadily grows longer.

pokedexEntries.si: This POKéMON is full of life energy. It continually sheds its skin and grows steadily larger.

pokedexEntries.cr: It sheds many layers of skin as it grows larger. During this process, it is protected by a rapid waterfall.

pokedexEntries.rs: DRATINI continually molts and sloughs off its old skin. It does so because the life energy within its body steadily builds to reach uncontrollable levels.

pokedexEntries.fr: Even the young can exceed 6.5 feet in length. It grows larger by repeatedly shedding skin.

pokedexEntries.lg: Long considered a mythical POKéMON until recently, when a small colony was found living underwater.

pokedexEntries.em: A DRATINI continually molts and sloughs off its old skin. It does so because the life energy within its body steadily builds to reach uncontrollable levels.

pokedexEntries.dpp: It is called the “Mirage Pokémon” because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.

pokedexEntries.hg: It is born large to start with. It repeatedly sheds its skin as it steadily grows longer.

pokedexEntries.ss: This Pokémon is full of life energy. It continually sheds its skin and grows steadily larger.

pokedexEntries.bw: It is called the “Mirage Pokémon” because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: It is called the “Mirage Pokémon” because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.

pokedexEntries.x: It is called the “Mirage Pokémon” because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.

pokedexEntries.y: This Pokémon is full of life energy. It continually sheds its skin and grows steadily larger.

pokedexEntries.oras: Dratini continually molts and sloughs off its old skin. It does so because the life energy within its body steadily builds to reach uncontrollable levels.

pokedexEntries.su: It grows by molting repeatedly. Boots made from the tanned cast-off skin are a super luxury item.

pokedexEntries.mo: After a 10-hour struggle, a fisherman was able to pull one up and confirm its existence.

pokedexEntries.us: It’s still weak, so it lurks on the floor of bodies of water, eating whatever food sinks down and living a quiet life.

pokedexEntries.um: It sheds its skin—almost on a daily basis—and grows larger. Its skin is soft just after it’s been shed.

pokedexEntries.lgpe: Long thought to be a myth, this Pokémon’s existence was only recently confirmed by a fisherman who caught one.

pokedexEntries.sw: Dratini dwells near bodies of rapidly flowing water, such as the plunge pools of waterfalls. As it grows, Dratini will shed its skin many times.

pokedexEntries.sh: This Pokémon was long considered to be no more than a myth. The small lump on a Dratini’s forehead is actually a horn that’s still coming in.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: It is called the Mirage Pokémon because so few have seen it, but its shed skin has been found.

pokedexEntries.sc: It sheds many layers of skin as it grows larger. During this process, it is protected by a rapid waterfall.
